summary: Backend-only Iteration 16 validated the super-admin phone migration and auth guardrails: retired phone is blocked, archived session token is rejected, active super-admin identity resolves on new phone, and WhatsBoost OTP provider checks were executed with provider path MOCKED where required.
action_items: No functional migration/auth fixes required for this scope.
Retire or update legacy /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py because it still assumes demo OTP 123456 and old seeded phones, which can create false failures/noise in future runs.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py remains a large monolith (>1500 lines), increasing regression risk and making security-sensitive auth changes harder to review safely.
Deprecated FastAPI startup/shutdown event hooks are still in use; plan migration to lifespan handlers.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. No live OTP was sent to the new super-admin phone.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md first. This run intentionally skipped frontend per request. Retired phone checks used in-process API tests with provider path MOCKED to ensure no WhatsBoost call is made.
rca_of_issue: No functional issue found in requested scope. Behavior is consistent with intended migration design: retired phone blocked pre-provider, archived sessions invalidated, and super-admin identity preserved on migrated phone.
